word:lxx:L702111.explanation: Attan is a proper name, referring to a person named Attan rather than describing an action, quality, or object. word:lxx:L702533.explanation: This verb means to weigh down or depress, describing something that places a heavy burden on a person or brings them into a lowered, discouraged condition. word:lxx:L703930.explanation: Ebia, also rendered Evia, is a proper name rather than a common word describing an action, quality, or object.
